items.title: Super Micro Has More Going for It Than Meets the Eye
items.summary: Supermicro shares have sold off hard even as its order backlog hit record levels and a preliminary quarter beat guidance. A single-digit forward multiple on a company growing faster than Dell raises a question worth examining before November 3.
